items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 26 at 12:29PM AKDT until May 27 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Delta Junction.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low relative humidities during Tuesday
afternoon dropping as low as 25% combined with gusty winds will
bring critical fire concerns. Blowing dust may reduce visibilities
in gusty winds.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued May 26 at 8:51AM AKDT until May 26 at 6:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The National Weather Service in Fairbanks has issued a Red Flag
Warning, which is in effect from noon today to 6 PM AKDT this
evening.

* AFFECTED AREA...Delta Junction.

* TIMING...From noon today to 6 PM AKDT this evening.

* WINDS...South 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* HUMIDITY...As low as 25 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...Highs in the lower 60s.

* IMPACTS...Critical fire weather conditions are expected today
due to a combination of low relative humidity, gusty winds from
the south, an
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.
